notes.title: Zakk hazards update
notes.content:
[u][b]Zakk hazard has been updated and now supports controllers[/b][/u]
Playing Zakk Hazard is still best played by mouse and keyboard. I have added joypad support and i hope that it run smoothly and add additional playability.

i hope you all enjoy playing Zakk hazard
happy gaming from Retrope studios
